data.title: Binance Completes WINk Lottery Draw and Will Open Trading For WIN
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed the WINk lottery draw, with a 23.87% ratio of winning tickets and 93.73% of participants winning at least one ticket. The results of the lottery draw are summarized below.

Binance will also open trading for WIN/BNB, WIN/BTC, WIN/USDT  and WIN/USDC trading pairs at 2019/08/01 10:00 AM (UTC).

WINk Listing Fee: 0 BNB.

Note:

  • Please ensure that you have sufficient BNB in your account based on the number of your winning tickets. We have started deducting BNB from winning accounts at 2019/07/31 08:00 AM (UTC), and users will have 24 hours until 2019/08/01 08:00 AM (UTC) to credit their accounts with BNB, at which point the distribution of WIN will be complete. 
  • The token purchase price was set at 1 WIN = 0.00000455 BNB/ 0.0001201 USD (using a BNB price of 26.3874 USD). as per the previous announcement here.
  • The WINk (WIN) TRC20 token smart contract is available on the explorer here https://tronscan.org/#/contract/TLa2f6VPqDgRE67v1736s7bJ8Ray5wYjU7 

For a full recap of the WINk token sale, read our blog post here.

To learn more about the WINk project, read the in-depth report by Binance Research here.

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/07/31
